notes:
### New

- Shows a progress bar while Agent HUD reads your agents' history for the first time, or again after an update that changes how it reads them. Tokens and costs are marked incomplete until it finishes.
- Shows the Mac's Tailscale address beside its local network address in Local network settings, and offers both to the iPhone.
- Tracks more than one Codex or Antigravity account, with a choice of how quotas are shown.
- Offers Claude Code a task with no project, as Codex has. Such tasks are kept in `~/.agenthud/sessions`, as in the Swift app.
- Opens a session's page when you click its row in the HUD panel.
- Copies words selected in the HUD with ⌘C.

### Fixes

- Shows each Claude Code message once on the iPhone, and what Claude writes while it works, not only its last reply.
- Compresses local network replies for an iPhone that asks for it, so readings arrive over slow links such as a Tailscale relay.
- Keeps Claude's last quota reading when Claude Code reports plan limits without numbers, and says why a detected agent has no reading, such as a Claude Code that needs signing in again.
- Says why a question card can't be answered on the Mac or the iPhone, and what would fix it.
- Carries more over from the Swift app: the Remote, local network and sharing switches with the pairing identity, the automatic update choices, and the quota history of Cursor, Antigravity and Grok Bot.
- Keeps iCloud on when the Swift app's usage ledger can't be imported.
- Reads only Claude Code sessions and their subagents as Claude logs, not workflow journals.
- Times each reply by its own call, so tool runs no longer pull the reply rate down; Copilot calls are timed by their own spans.
- Lets you quit from Settings, and lets Transparency clear the HUD's background fully.
- Names the running app in the Login Items approval notice.
- Removes the grey bands from the notch panel's shadow.
